useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

title:
The {@link MlAccuracyMetric} computes the overall ratio of correct predictions, among all predictions made. It
works for both binary and multi-class classification.
The `modelOutput` and `targetOutput` are expected to have the same shape, and if multi-label (i.e. multiple "columns"),
each "row" of labels is treated as a single prediction.
This metric supports `sampleWeights` as `context`. `sampleWeights` is single-dimensional with same number of samples
as the `modelOutput`. It represents a per-sample weighting when aggregating for accuracy calculation.
name: MlAccuracyMetric
